name: facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distributed_LaNAS/server/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.create_classifier: create a Classifier instance with samples dictionary and input dimension for neural architecture search
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.train_classifier: train the Classifier model using MSE loss on network samples and accuracy labels
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.predict_accuracy: predict accuracy scores for remaining network architectures using the trained Classifier model
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.split_predictions: split predicted network architectures into good and bad samples based on average accuracy threshold
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.split_data: train the Classifier and split existing samples into good and bad based on predicted mean accuracy

facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.create_mcts_agent: create an MCTS agent with a search space, tree height, and architecture code length
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.run_mcts_search: run the MCTS search loop to explore neural architecture search space with distributed job dispatch
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.select_mcts_leaf: select a leaf node from the MCTS tree using UCT values for architecture sampling
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.backpropagate_mcts_rewards: backpropagate accuracy rewards from a leaf node up to the root through the MCTS tree
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.dispatch_mcts_jobs: dispatch architecture evaluation jobs to a server and retrieve accuracy results from clients

facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.create_Node_tree: create a Node object as the root of a MCTS search tree with an architecture code length
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.collect_sample_Node: collect an architecture sample with its accuracy into the Node bag for training
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.train_Node_classifier: train the Node classifier to split data into good and bad kid datasets
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.predict_Node_split: predict and split the Node bag into good and bad kid data using the classifier
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.sample_arch_Node: sample a random architecture from the Node bag and remove it for evaluation

facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.init_net_trainer: create a Net_Trainer instance that loads architecture data from features.json
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.train_net: train a neural network architecture and return its accuracy score
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.print_best_traces: print the best training traces sorted by accuracy so far
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.review_net_trainer_class: review the Net_Trainer class and its architecture search capabilities
facebookresearch_lamcts/LaNAS/Distribute.summarize_train_net: summarize the train_net method that evaluates network architectures against a dataset
